import re
from collections import defaultdict

def parse_auth_log(log_lines):
    failed_logins = defaultdict(int)
    
    # Regex to match failed login attempts
    pattern = re.compile(r'Failed password for invalid user|Failed password for user (\S+)')
    
    for line in log_lines:
        match = pattern.search(line)
        if match:
            ip = line.split()[0]  # Assuming IP is the first field
            failed_logins[ip] += 1
    
    return failed_logins

def main():
    # Sample log lines for testing
    log_lines = [
        "192.168.1.1 - - [15/Jan/2024:12:00:00 +0000] " + "Failed password for invalid user",
        "192.168.1.2 - - [15/Jan/2024:12:00:10 +0000] " + "Failed password for user admin",
        "192.168.1.1 - - [15/Jan/2024:12:00:20 +0000] " + "Failed password for user root",
        "192.168.1.3 - - [15/Jan/2024:12:00:30 +0000] " + "Failed password for user admin"
    ]
    
    failed_logins = parse_auth_log(log_lines)
    
    for ip, count in failed_logins.items():
        print(f"IP: {ip}, Failed Login Attempts: {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
